study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: 171 nulliparous women diagnosed with placenta previa on midtrimester ultrasound, from the Nulliparous Pregnancy Outcomes Study: Monitoring Mothers-to-be (nuMoM2b)
finding: In nulliparous women with midtrimester placenta previa, older maternal age, previous pregnancy of <20 weeks, and in vitro fertilization are associated with persistent placenta previa at delivery.
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweight was lower in the persistent placenta previa group (median, 2847 g [interquartile range, 2655-3310] vs 3263 g [interquartile range, 2855-3560])
